input.title: Give the quantity field the accessible name "Quantity"
input.rationale: The input #qty has no accessible name. A visible <label>Quantity</label> sits just before it on line 11, but it has no for attribute and doesn't wrap the input, so it isn't linked to the field. I can only edit the flagged element, so this patch adds aria-label="Quantity" to the input. That matches the visible label text, so the spoken name and the on-screen text stay the same. A better source fix, outside what I can edit here, is to add for="qty" to the <label> on line 11. That also lets users click the label to focus the field. If you make that change, you can remove the aria-label. After applying, please check with a screen reader.
